name: YJ Windmill Cube V3
description: The YJ Windmill Cube V3 is a 3x3 shape mod that adds a fun twist to solving. Instead of turning like a normal cube, its offset layers create wild shapes and patterns as you scramble it. Despite the unusual look, it solves using familiar 3x3 methods with a bit of extra spatial awareness. It’s a great pick for anyone who wants a classic challenge with a fresh visual spin.
